verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a prospective 96–102-page adaptation artifact; the page target is a concrete deliverable criterion rather than merely a quotation deadline.
The freelancer explicitly identifies an unresolved distinction between screenplay pages and comic pages that materially affects the adaptation artifact.

The client specifies a 102-comic-page target and identifies the scripts and novel as source materials to review for the adaptation; the replacement of the existing page-count value leaves no stale key.
The client resolves the page-type ambiguity, allowing the adaptation requirement to return from clarification to active consideration.
The exact story coverage and whether the scripted artifact should be self-contained or end with a continuation hook remain materially unresolved.
The client explicitly states that no additional adaptation work is currently requested, deferring the deliverable pending campaign funding.
